name: paf-tasks
description: phone-a-friend, made legible: every review as a thread of rounds with its verdict and findings, live progress while a reviewer works, and the agent sessions that need you

panel.title: Side panel shows
panel.description: both (Reviews and Agents tabs), calls (phone-a-friend reviews only) or agents (herdr agent sessions only)

auto_open.title: Open the panel by itself
auto_open.description: Open the side panel by itself once there are reviews to show (until you close it)

band.title: Line above the prompt
band.description: One line for a running or just-finished call: auto (only while the panel is not on screen), always, or never

transcript.title: Draw calls in the conversation
transcript.description: Show a phone-a-friend call in the transcript as a call (who was asked, the verdict, the findings) instead of the shell command and its raw output
